# Execution Trace Summary

The harness demonstrates consistently poor performance across all three datasets, with eval accuracies ranging from 35–38%—well below acceptable thresholds. A dominant recurring failure pattern emerges: the model exhibits severe label bias, repeatedly predicting the same label regardless of input (e.g., "brako-rudor" in alpha, "brati-xolun" in beta, "braya-solpas" in gamma). This suggests the in-context demonstrations are either ineffective or the model is not properly leveraging them during classification. While ds_gamma shows slightly more prediction diversity than the others, all three datasets indicate the harness has fundamentally failed to learn meaningful patterns from the training examples. The offline learning phase (84–180 training steps per dataset) appears insufficient to establish reliable label discrimination or demonstration selection mechanisms.
